Green-scaled giant with a snake's tail and head, crescent mark on brow. The progenitor of all snakes.

AC 14, HP 72, ATK 2 bite +10 (3d10 + curse of Yig + poison), MV double near (climb, fly, swim), S +5, D +4, C +5, I +5, W +5, Ch +5, AL C, LV 15

Curse of Yig. CHA 18+ or cursed, DISADV against poison.

Madness. Warps reality for all mortals within far. Each turn, WIS 18+ or cursed, DISADV on checks against curses. On success, immune.

Poison. CON 18+ or reduced to 0 HP with a death timer of 1.

Pure Evil. Only damaged by magic sources. If destroyed, reborn from a venomous serpent's egg, matures into Yig over centuries.
